items.claim: Jackson McVey was submitted in the first round of his UFC debut by Bruno Fa.
items.quote: He lost to Bruno Fa in his UFC debut. All right, Bruno's decent. Like, that's not the worst loss in the world. But he was subbed in the first round.

items.claim: Jackson McVey lost to Zach Reese via takedowns and submission.
items.quote: Loses to Zach Reese. Zach Reese actually is not that good. We have figured that out by now. And not only did he lose to Zachary Reese, Zach Reese basically just took him down as many times he wanted to, held him on the ground, eventually submitted him

items.claim: Jackson McVey has decent striking and can manage his range well at 6'4.
items.quote: He's got decent strike. He's a big dude at 6'4. He can man his range. He'll throw out some kicks.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has major weaknesses in his takedown defense.
items.quote: he has giant holes in my opinion in the takedown defense.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz is a pure wrestler whose striking is very poor.
items.quote: Wesley Schultz is a wrestler through and through. It's not even worth talking about anything else because his striking absolutely sucked.

items.claim: Wesley Schultz was an undefeated high school wrestler going 47-0, and earned All-American honors in junior college and division three.
items.quote: Wesley Schultz went 47 and0 in high school... all-American in junior college... all-American there as well.
